name: range_bands
about: The attack bands, one at a time. A hostile gunman with a firearm and NO melee weapon (no alternateequipment; GiveBaseFightingItems 0x102b5b20 gives fists only when slot 307 and slot 308 both refuse, and the .38 is ranged) and no usable cover (hint_groups 2) fires from the open. GatherAttackConditions 0x1026dd10 clears slot 560's set at its top (ClearAttackConditions 0x1026dc80: 0x4f 0x50 0x51 0x52 0x2e 0x2f 0x62 0x63 0x64 0x65 0x66 -- NOT the band words 0x08 / 0x5f / 0x60 / 0x09), sets the ONE answer of the weapon band, and its tail (0x1026e0b0..0x1026e107) clears 0x08 / 0x5f / 0x60 / 0x09 / 0x63 on any gather where a CAN_* holds and m_flWeaponBlockedByFriendTimer has lapsed (corrected 2026-10-04 by V2: the record first claimed a full clear, and its probes sampled only after a program change, so it could not see known red 2; the probe at 16.2 s is the tail's) (weapon slot 365 0x1024f670: d < 100 -> TOO_CLOSE_FOR_RANGED 0x08; d < m_fMinRange1 -> TOO_CLOSE_TO_ATTACK 0x5f; d > m_fMaxRange1 -> TOO_FAR_TO_ATTACK 0x60; dot < 0.5 -> NOT_FACING_ATTACK 0x61; else CAN_RANGE_ATTACK1 0x4f; conditions-and-states.md 'The attack bands are fixed numbers'). At 6 s the player is put 96 cm (37.8 units) in front of it: only 0x08 holds. 0x08 is not in RANGE_ATTACK1's interrupt list, so the running program ends; the next selection (0x10386560 step 3 needs slot 307, refused; step 7 / Troika ladder 0x102af660: 0x08 with a 0x6000 weapon and neither 0x2f nor 0x63) answers 0x102b7f40 ? 0xef SCHED_TROIKA_STEP_BACK_RANGE_ATTACK1 : 0xf0 SCHED_TROIKA_FORCED_RANGE_ATTACK1 (0x102b7f40: an ACT 0x10 sequence, no STOP_BACKUP, RandomInt < 75). sched_troika_step_back_range_attack1.sch: STOP_MOVING, RESOLVE_BOTCH, FACE_ENEMY, ANNOUNCE_ATTACK, TASK_RANGE_ATTACK1, SET_FAIL_SCHEDULE COMBAT_FACE, WAIT_FINISH_SET 1.2, WAIT_FINISH_ADD_RANDOM 1.3, TASK_STEP_BACK, RESOLVE_BOTCH, WAIT_ATTACK_TIME1. At 16 s the player is put 10 m away: only CAN_RANGE_ATTACK1 holds, and the ladder answers RANGE_ATTACK1: face, fire.
notes: Staging (V4o): since the event shot (CWeaponRanged 0x10238160 -> Shot 0x102387b0) an NPC's 3031 commits its bullets, 15 a set from the .38 here, and a 100-health player dies at the seventh; the record is about the gunman, so the player is held by retail's own unkillable latch, an events_player row's MakePlayerUnkillable input, from t=0.05. Stage96cm in front of the measured position, preserving t6, t16, all condition predicates/deadlines and seed1. 0x1024f670 too-close cutoff100 Source units; corrected distance37.8 units.
